newsitem.title: USA: Conversion names new CEO and president.
newsitem.headline: Conversion names new CEO and president.

text.p: Conversion Technologies International Inc on Monday named William Amt as its new president and chief executive officer.

Amt, who will also be nominated for election to the board of directors, formerly served as president and chief executive of Octagon Inc, a provider of radiological control maintenance services, Conversion Technologies said in a statement.
Amt succeeds Eckardt Beck, who will remain as the company's chairman, the company said.
Conversion Technologies manufactures and recycles substrates and advanced materials to be used as industrial abrasives.
